the question of how the accuracy of recommendations for items that are not yet explicitly rated by the user can be improved by leveraging short-term user interests.
the design and evaluation of recommendation algorithms that are able to adapt to the user’s short-term interests in order to increase the relevance and the perceived quality of the recommendations.
the question of how contextualized recommendation strategies can be evaluated and which strategies can be expected to be beneficial for real-world scenarios.
